_comment: APIDOC-1: the CURATED one-line summary per API route for the generated reference (tools/setup/New-PimApiReference.ps1), keyed 'METHOD /path' exactly as the reference prints it. Public text: plain language, what the route does for its caller -- no internal names, no customer names, never how a check works or what it does not check (no attack hints). A route without an entry is published as its method + path.
GET /api/access-report/who-can: Everything one person can reach, with the path to each.
GET /api/access-report/who-has: Everyone who can activate one role or target.
GET /api/access-review-campaigns: The access review campaigns: what is open, for whom and how far along.
POST /api/access-review-campaigns/decide: Keep or remove one person in an access review campaign.
GET /api/access-review-rules: The access review rules and the departments they apply to.
GET /api/access-reviews: The access reviews: definitions, current instances, decisions and counts.
POST /api/access-reviews/decision: Record one access review decision, with a justification.
GET /api/access-reviews/evidence: The evidence package of one access review instance.
GET /api/access-reviews/overdue: The access reviews that are overdue or due soon.
POST /api/access-reviews/reminders: Send a reminder to the reviewers of the reviews that are due.
POST /api/access-reviews/reviewers: Set who is asked to review in one access review.
GET /api/account-states: The state of every administrator account, in plain words.
GET /api/activator: What this environment has for the PIM Activator browser extension, and the commands to roll it out.
GET /api/active-assignments: The active and eligible PIM assignments right now, paged and filterable.
GET /api/admin-templates: The prepared administrator templates the onboarding wizard offers.
GET /api/alerting: Who receives alerts and which events send one.
PUT /api/alerting: Save the alert recipients and events.
GET /api/alerts: The alerts that were raised: when, which event and who was told.
GET /api/approvals: The changes waiting for a second person.
POST /api/approvals: Ask for a change that needs a second person to approve it.
POST /api/approvals/decide: Approve or deny one waiting change (never your own).
GET /api/asbuilt: The as-built description of this environment.
GET /api/asbuilt/pdf: The as-built document of this environment, as a PDF.
GET /api/attention: What waits for a person right now (the counts on the menu).
GET /api/audit: The audit trail: who changed what, and when.
GET /api/audit/export: The audit trail as a download.
POST /api/autoextend/decide: Extend one upcoming auto-extension or let it end, with a reason.
GET /api/autoextend/upcoming: The access that runs out soon and what auto-extend will do with each.
GET /api/commit-history/{p1}: One saved change and its rows, by its id.
GET /api/commit-status/{p1}: What happened to a commit, by its id.
GET /api/commits: The recent commits and how far each change has come.
POST /api/company-review/answer: Answer for one person in a company review.
GET /api/company-reviews: The company reviews and their answers.
GET /api/config: The delegation model the page draws its views from.
GET /api/conformance: How far this environment is from the latest template versions.
POST /api/conformance/deploy: Apply an approved template version to this environment.
GET /api/conformance/exemptions: The template exemptions and the state of each.
POST /api/conformance/exemptions: Add an exemption from a template.
POST /api/conformance/promote: Move a template version to the next ring.
GET /api/conformance/ring-plan: Where a template version would go next, ring by ring.
GET /api/coverage: Privileged access in the tenant that PIM does not manage yet (the last coverage report).
POST /api/coverage/check: Build a new coverage report now.
POST /api/coverage/ignore: Ignore a coverage gap, or bring it back.
GET /api/custom-workloads: The custom workloads and where each is used.
POST /api/custom-workloads: Create or update a custom workload.
POST /api/custom-workloads/delete: Delete a custom workload that is no longer used.
GET /api/custom-workloads/export: One custom workload as a template file.
GET /api/demo-data/status: Whether this page shows demo data.
GET /api/directory/groups: Look up groups in the directory by name.
GET /api/directory/people: Look up people in the directory by name.
GET /api/discovered-resources: The resources found in the tenant since the last acknowledgement.
POST /api/discovery-baseline: Acknowledge the resources found so far.
POST /api/discovery-decisions: Create, ignore or re-add one discovered item.
GET /api/discovery-inbox: The newly discovered items waiting for a decision.
GET /api/discovery-policy: What happens with each kind of newly discovered resource.
PUT /api/discovery-policy: Save what happens with each kind of newly discovered resource.
GET /api/docs: The product documentation shipped with this version.
GET /api/docs/page: One page of the product documentation.
GET /api/whats-new: What's new in every release of this product: new features and fixes, one entry per version.
GET /api/downlink: What the managing tenant sends to each managed tenant.
GET /api/downlink-intents: The removals the managing tenant has decided for managed tenants.
PUT /api/downlink/policy: Save what is sent to one managed tenant.
GET /api/downlink/reach: Which managed tenants each group reaches.
GET /api/drift: Where the tenant differs from the configuration (the last drift snapshot).
PUT /api/drift/ignore: Ignore a drift finding, with a reason.
PUT /api/drift/settings: Set how often the drift mail is sent.
GET /api/engine-failures: The items the engine could not apply on its last run, with the cause and the fix.
GET /api/engine/azres-policy-hold: The held Azure role policy changes waiting for approval.
GET /api/engine/policy-hold: The held policy changes waiting for approval.
GET /api/engine/policy-hold/xlsx: The held policy changes as an Excel workbook, for a change board.
GET /api/environment-report: The architecture and settings report of this environment.
POST /api/export: A view as an Excel or PDF file.
GET /api/export/capabilities: Which export formats this environment can make.
GET /api/group-states: The state of every group, in plain words.
POST /api/groups/adopt: Adopt one group that waits for adoption.
GET /api/guards: The guards that stopped a change, newest first.
GET /api/home: The tiles of the Overview page.
POST /api/hybrid-ad/discovery/preview: How many servers the given discovery settings would find.
GET /api/hybrid-ad/live: The latest passes of the Active Directory sync.
POST /api/hybrid-ad/server-groups/approv: Approve the waiting list of new server groups.
GET /api/hybrid-ad/server-groups/waiting: The new server groups waiting for approval.
GET /api/hybrid-ad/waiting: The Active Directory groups whose membership sync waits for a decision.
GET /api/impact: The impact counters of the Dashboard.
GET /api/job-schedule: The engine jobs, whether each is on, and how often each runs.
POST /api/job-schedule/run-now: Start one scheduled job at once.
GET /api/jobs: The engine jobs with their last and next run.
POST /api/jobs/ack: Acknowledge a failed run, or take the acknowledgement back.
POST /api/jobs/cancel: Cancel the running run of one engine job.
GET /api/jobs/history: The recent runs of one engine job.
GET /api/jobs/log: The log of one job run.
PUT /api/jobs/state: Switch one engine job on or off, or change how often it runs.
GET /api/mail-notifications: Who receives which reports and alerts by mail.
PUT /api/mail-notifications: Save who receives which reports and alerts by mail.
DELETE /api/mail-template: Put one mail template back to the shipped text.
GET /api/mail-templates: The mail templates and whether each was edited.
GET /api/map-risk: The risk marks on the Delegation Map.
GET /api/map-search: Find a node on the Delegation Map.
GET /api/msp/deployment-rings: The deployment rings of the managing tenant and the tenants on each.
GET /api/msp/replication/context: Whether this is the managing tenant, and the tenants and tags a change can target.
GET /api/msp/replication/overview: Every replicated item and the tenants it reaches.
POST /api/msp/replication/reach: How many tenants a change would reach.
GET /api/msp/tenant-tags: The tenant tags a change can target.
GET /api/naming-conventions: The naming conventions for groups and accounts.
POST /api/owner/extend: Extend one person's access to a new date, with a reason.
POST /api/owner/keep: Keep one person's access for another period, with a reason.
GET /api/owner/people: The people a department owner is asked to review.
POST /api/owner/remove: Ask for one person to be offboarded, with a reason.
GET /api/pending: Every change staged by every administrator, not yet saved.
POST /api/pending-discard: Discard one staged change, with a reason.
POST /api/pending-discard-all: Discard every staged change, with a reason.
PUT /api/pending/{p1}: Stage your changes to one list.
GET /api/permissions-health: Whether this environment holds the permissions it needs.
GET /api/policy-choices: For each policy setting: the Microsoft default, the recommendation and the current value.
PUT /api/policy-choices: Choose which value each policy setting should have.
GET /api/policy-templates: The policy templates and where each is used.
PUT /api/policy-templates/rules: Save the settings of a policy template.
GET /api/preflight: Check the saved configuration for problems.
POST /api/preflight: Check the configuration with the staged changes for problems.
GET /api/queue: The change queue: what is waiting to be applied.
POST /api/queue/commit: Commit queued changes so the engine applies them.
POST /api/queue/discard: Discard queued changes that are waiting or failed, with a reason.
POST /api/reconcile/pause: Pause the daily reconcile, with a reason.
GET /api/reconcile/state: Whether the daily reconcile is paused, and its last removal report.
GET /api/reports/management: The management report as a PowerPoint file.
GET /api/reports/management/latest: The latest stored monthly management report.
GET /api/reports/management/settings: The settings of the monthly management report.
PUT /api/reports/management/settings: Save the settings of the monthly management report.
GET /api/resolve-date: What a date expression resolves to.
POST /api/rfa/decide: Approve or deny one access request.
GET /api/rfa/requests: The access requests you can see.
GET /api/role-lookup/compare: Compare who and what two roles reach.
GET /api/role-permissions/by-action: The roles that grant one action, narrowest first.
POST /api/scheduler/kick: Start the engine now to apply the latest commit.
GET /api/search: Search admins, groups, roles and definitions.
PUT /api/settings/activator-targets: Set the group the PIM Activator is deployed to.
GET /api/settings/admin-domain: The domain administrator accounts are created in.
PUT /api/settings/admin-domain: Set the domain administrator accounts are created in.
PUT /api/settings/invardia-connect: Community: connect this install to Invardia (health reports and updates on request), or stop it.
PUT /api/settings/approvers: Retired: the approvers list is no longer used.
POST /api/settings/approvers/import: Import department approvers and owners from a CSV file.
GET /api/settings/audit-retention: How long the audit trail is kept.
PUT /api/settings/audit-retention: Set how long the audit trail is kept.
POST /api/settings/departments/import: Import departments from groups in the directory.
PUT /api/settings/environment-name: Set the name of this environment.
GET /api/settings/hide-names: Whether names are hidden (retired: names are always shown).
GET /api/settings/hybrid-ad: The naming for PIM groups in Active Directory.
PUT /api/settings/hybrid-ad: Save the naming for PIM groups in Active Directory.
GET /api/settings/hybrid-ad-discovery: The server discovery settings for Active Directory.
PUT /api/settings/hybrid-ad-discovery: Save the server discovery settings for Active Directory.
GET /api/settings/info-catalog: The text of the More info panels on the settings pages.
PUT /api/settings/mail/mailbox: Save the shared mailbox mail is sent from.
POST /api/settings/mail/mailbox/use: Start sending mail from the saved shared mailbox.
GET /api/settings/naming-catalog: The naming settings the Get Started page asks for.
GET /api/settings/operational-policy: The default expiry and activation settings.
PUT /api/settings/operational-policy: Save the default expiry and activation settings.
PUT /api/settings/pending-reminders: Save the reminder about pending actions.
PUT /api/settings/policy-template-defaul: Set the default policy template for each kind of policy.
GET /api/settings/portal-branding: The company name and contact address the access request portal shows.
PUT /api/settings/portal-branding: Set the company name and contact address the access request portal shows.
GET /api/template-file/export: This installation's departments, groups, delegations, admin accounts and policy-template links as one template file.
POST /api/template-file/import: Check a template file, show what it would create and change, and stage its rows for review.
GET /api/template-state: Which permission templates are switched off.
PUT /api/template-state: Switch a permission template on or off.
GET /api/templates: The permission templates and what importing each would add.
GET /api/tenant-lists: The lists of roles, groups and scopes read from the tenant.
GET /api/tier-impact: Who can reach your most sensitive roles and groups, and through what.
GET /api/unmanaged-admins: Privileged accounts in the tenant that PIM does not manage, with what they hold.
GET /api/unmanaged-admins/import: What importing one unmanaged account into PIM would stage.
GET /api/update-ring: The version running here and the update ring this environment is on.
GET /api/workload-crawl: The last crawl of the workloads.
GET /api/workload-prereqs: The prerequisites of each workload and whether each is met.
POST /api/workload-prereqs/confirm: Confirm, skip or withdraw one workload prerequisite.
GET /api/workload-recon: How the workload assignments compare with what the crawl found.
